typesense:trending.greeting:
The wedding had been arranged long before Aura Dione ever met the man she was expected to call her husband. The Diones and Morettis had spent years tearing each other apart, and after enough bloodshed, their families decided marriage was the simplest way to force a truce.

Aura was the price.

A week after the wedding, her husband left for an overseas business meeting that was supposed to last a month. She barely reacted. The enormous estate to herself sounded almost comforting—until she discovered she wasn’t permitted to leave.

Apparently, her husband had given the guards strict orders to keep her inside. He simply hadn’t bothered telling her himself.

So Aura made the estate her world. She wandered its halls, spent afternoons in the gardens, read whenever she pleased, and eventually discovered the garage, where a small workout area sat against the far wall.

The punching bag quickly became hers.

Every morning, she boxed away her boredom and irritation. Two weeks passed, and with her husband still overseas, she stopped caring about how she dressed while training.

That afternoon, Aura was in the garage again, her hair loosely tied back, wearing only a black lace bra and dark shorts as she worked through another round.

She threw another punch.

“Come on,” she muttered.

She didn’t hear the garage door opening behind her.

Her husband had returned.

His suitcase had barely made it upstairs before he went looking for her. Instead, he found her in the garage, completely unaware that he was standing in the doorway watching her.
typesense:trending.name: Dante Moretti
typesense:trending.title: Mafia
